name: Cinderbrand
text: Melee attacks also send a wave of fire forward for 70% weapon damage.

name: Trident of Embers
text: Pierce skills throw 3 projectiles in a fan.

name: Gauntlets of the Tide
text: Pierce projectiles fly back to you at the end of their path, hitting again.

name: Grip of the Reaper
text: Every 3rd melee attack hits all around you for double damage.

name: Pyre Mail
text: Fire skills ignite enemies, burning for 90% of the hit over 3 seconds.

name: Heart of Ash
text: Enemies killed by fire skills explode for 35% of their max life.

name: Comet Treads
text: Dash skills leave a burning trail for 3 seconds.

name: Hollow Diadem
text: Your minions explode for 250% weapon damage when they expire.
